verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships an official BugSnag CLI, documented on its own docs site. Its documented scope is narrow: build integration, meaning creating releases and builds and uploading files such as source maps to improve stack traces. Nothing shows the CLI can query or triage errors, or that it is designed for agent or AI-native workflows. missing for 10: CLI access to errors/projects/triage operations, agent- or AI-oriented CLI usage (e.g., machine-readable output for agents), independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The BugSnag CLI can be used to simplify the process of creating releases on the BugSnag dashboard and uploading files to improve the stacktraces in your errors.
Allows you to create a build within BugSnag to enrich releases shown in the BugSnag dashboard.
